notes: A non-LLMError exception (RuntimeError raised inside a FakeLLM._raw) in the assistance agent propagates out of team.answer rather than giving a card; real clients wrap errors as LLMError, so it is not a stated requirement, but worth hardening. Wall time on a hung call can exceed the deadline by the margin (about 0.5s, 1.5s vs 1.0s deadline); this is by design. After repeated hangs, abandoned threads accumulate until a cap makes later calls fail fast (abstained, not a hang).
